text:
lee: Quick postmortem sync — two canary regressions looked very similar (tokenizer mismatch + silent model swap). We should lock down rollout defaults and track owners.

tara: Yep. Can we define minimum safe rollout config + explicit auto-rollback signals and an owner for each action item?

josh: Proposed safe defaults: initial 0.25%, hold 4m, next 2.5%, then 10%. Max canary 3%. Auto-rollback triggers: +4pp error rate sustained for 4m, OR p95 +180ms sustained 3m, OR schema errors >0.15%.

lee: I like the conservative start. Add requirement: pre-rollout model-compat check (tokenizer + vocab) AND disallow model binary swaps during rollout window.

anita: I'll own monitoring/runbook updates. I'll add clear pager rules: sev2+ to oncall, sev3 to #eng-platform slack.

josh: I'll own the rollback rule wiring and smoke harness. Plan: add smoke test that validates schema + a subset of golden prompts. PR ETA Mon 10:00 UTC.

lee: Draft rollout snippet (will push to repo):

```yaml
rollout_policy: "safety-first"
initial_batch: "0.25%"
progression: ["2.5%","10%"]
hold_time: "4m"
max_blast_radius: "3%"
rollback_rules:
  - id: error_spike
    metric: error_rate
    delta: 0.04
    window: 4m
  - id: latency_regression
    metric: p95_latency
    delta_ms: 180
    window: 3m
  - id: schema_failures
    metric: schema_errors
    threshold: 0.0015
smoke_test:
  run_after_each_batch: true
  checks: [schema, golden_prompts, malformed_response_rate]
pre_rollout_checks: [tokenizer_compat, no_model_swap, model-diff-on-canary]
auto_rollback: true
```

anita: I'll add runbook text that explains each rollback rule and the exact page/override flow.

tara: Create a tracking card INF-6201 and assign owners: josh -> rollback impl + smoke tests; lee -> config + infra deploy; anita -> monitoring + runbook; tara -> validation & PM signoff. Deadlines: smoke tests + PR Mon EOD, infra review Tue, staged rollouts Wed.

devops-bot: Tracking card INF-6201 created by @tara; milestone: Rollout guardrails Q2.

josh: I'll also add circuit-breaker tagging so canary traffic is separated and an automated kill-switch if cumulative error impacts other services.

lee: Good call. Also adding monthly "Canary Incident Patterns" review invite; we'll log incident triage notes there and adjust thresholds if patterns repeat.

anita: Noting the repeating pattern: last 4 incidents had either a tokenizer/codecs mismatch or an uncoordinated model swap. Adding mandatory "no model swap during rollout" policy.

tara: I'll update INF-6201 with the model compatibility checklist and link to the model-diff tool.

josh: PR link (draft): https://internal.redwood/INF-6201/rollout-proposal. Will tag reviewers.

lee: Once PRs & runbook are linked to INF-6201 we can consider relaxing defaults later. For now keep them strict. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
